system.description: Your unarmed and clubbing attacks inflict lethal rather than bashing damage if you choose. Once per game session you may also restore all of your used Brawny, Ferocious, Stalwart, Tough, and Wiry Physical Traits at once. Prowess costs nothing and isn't an action - it can be used at any time.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, p.150
